major_events: Confronting Candle Dragon's Residual Will: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第468章 天与地，冰与火', Su Ming uses the Nine-Headed Nine-Baby phantom from the Hantuo Clock to battle the residual consciousness of Candle Dragon (Zhu Jiu Yin), resulting in a clash that triggers the fusion of their antagonistic wills.

Opening the Undying and Indestructible World: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第470章 不死不灭界', the fusion of the primeval beasts opens a mystical trial domain known as the Undying and Indestructible World, forcing Su Ming's consciousness to adapt or perish.

Refining the Undying Soul: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第478章 不死不灭……开！', Su Ming endures countless cycles of destruction and reconstruction, refining his soul into an undying soul and breaking through the boundaries of the Undying and Indestructible gate.

Receiving Candle Dragon's Legacy Blessing: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第480章 烛九阴的祝福！', Su Ming is granted the Candle Dragon's Blessing, which manifests as numerous World/Boundary fragments (位界/界力碎片), laying the foundation for his future Destiny Cultivation.

Encountering the Destiny Clan: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第486章 命族（下）', Su Ming exits the Candle Dragon's body and enters the desolate land of the Destiny Clan (命族), adopting the alias 'Mo Su' (墨苏) to hide his identity.

Drawing the Destiny Clan's Fiend Bow: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第489章 煞弓！', Su Ming successfully draws the legendary Fiend Bow of the Destiny Clan, using its immense pressure to deter enemies and establish himself as a savior figure for the clan.

Traversing the Yin Spirit Realm: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第496章 闯阴灵！', Su Ming ventures into the hazardous Yin Spirit region to secure a poison corpse (毒尸) and seek a way out of the sealed dimensional pocket.

Entering the Mirror World and Waking the Boundary Spirit: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第504章 界灵之醒！', Su Ming navigates the Mirror World to awaken the Boundary Spirit (界灵) and interacts with the Destiny Woman (宿女), discovering the mechanics of destiny cultivation.

Displaying Destiny Glory in Defense: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第520章 命族的荣耀！', Su Ming coordinates with the Destiny Clan to activate their ancient defenses and ward off hostile entities during a critical spatial collapse.

Shooting the Boundary-Splitting Arrow: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第531章 何惜一命逆沧桑！', Su Ming exhausts his vitality and utilizes the Fiend Bow to shoot a world-rending arrow, cracking open the boundary of the pocket dimension.

Escaping the Pocket Dimension: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第541章 离去！', Su Ming successfully guides the surviving Destiny Clan members out of the collapsing pocket dimension and returns to the changed Barbarian Lands.

Arriving at Ta Mu Tribe: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第550章 塔牧部', Su Ming locates a local Barbarian tribe (Ta Mu tribe) and integrates himself there, hiding his cultivation while observing the state of Nan Chen.

Seizing the Hostile Cultivator's Magical Fan: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第559章 此扇，归我了！', Su Ming intervenes in a tribal conflict and forcefully claims a powerful magical fan from an invading cultivator, demonstrating his absolute dominance.

Experiencing Brief Solace with Bai Su: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第569章 温暖', Su Ming meets Bai Su, a female cultivator from the Immortals' Evil Sect, and enjoys a brief period of peace and warmth amidst the looming chaos of the descending Immortals.

Wounding Di Tian's Projection: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第590章 第九道大礼！', Su Ming executes a highly planned ambush against Di Tian's avatar, using a sequence of nine traps, culminating in stabbing Di Tian's chest with the Barbarian God Needle (蛮神刺).

Infiltrating the Evil Sect: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第601章 邪宗！', Su Ming enters the Evil Sect (Xie Zong) by pretending to be a low-level cultivator, seeking to heal his injuries and understand the sect's deployment.

Refining the Soul in the Mortal World: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第642章 魂在人间！', Su Ming makes the critical choice to refine his soul in the mortal world, successfully achieving a breakthrough to the Barbarian Soul (蛮魂) realm.

Stepping onto the Path of Destiny Cultivation: In the chapter '第三卷 名震东荒 第705章 修行之路', after surviving intense battles and the descent of Di Tian, Su Ming reflects on the relationship between Barbarian Soul, Destiny Cultivation (命修), and the Immortal steps (World Boundary Master / 位界之主), formally establishing his path forward.

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Undying and Indestructible World Trial Loop
long_form_mechanisms.description: A sub-world created by the friction and fusion of the Candle Dragon and Nine-Baby wills. Entering consciousnesses are subjected to continuous disintegration and reconstruction. The challenger must prevent their identity from dissolving by focusing their willpower on core memories. If they maintain awareness through thousands of cycles, their soul is refined into an Undying Soul (不灭魂), granting them resistance to mental collapse and high-level soul-erasure techniques.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第478章 不死不灭……开！

long_form_mechanisms.name: Candle Dragon's Boundary Blessing
long_form_mechanisms.description: Upon completing the trial, the Candle Dragon bestows a blessing containing 97 Boundary/World fragments (位界碎片). These fragments contain the raw authority of world boundaries. When absorbed by a cultivator, they function as catalyst seeds that allow the user to manipulate local spatial laws and boundary forces, serving as the essential fuel required to transition from a physical cultivator to a Destiny Cultivator (命修).
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第480章 烛九阴的祝福！

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Destiny Clan's Fiend Bow Resonance
long_form_mechanisms.description: The Fiend Bow (煞弓) is a legacy weapon that does not rely on physical strength. Instead, it extracts the user's lifeforce, bloodline purity, and archery intent. When drawn, the bow generates an oppressive field of fiend energy (煞气) that suppresses opponents. Firing an arrow requires the user to project their mental focus as the arrow's trajectory, allowing the projectile to bypass physical armor and directly strike the target's destiny line, though it drains the user's vitality severely.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第489章 煞弓！

long_form_mechanisms.name: Mirror World Spatial Mirroring
long_form_mechanisms.description: A spatial barrier where reality is split into mirrored twins. Actions in the real space are reflected in the mirror space, but the flow of energy is reversed. To escape or wake the Boundary Spirit (界灵), a cultivator must find the non-symmetrical point (the anomaly that does not match its reflection). By targeting this asymmetry with localized force, the mirror surface is shattered, opening a physical rift (缺口) through which the cultivator can transition between dimensions.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第504章 界灵之醒！

long_form_mechanisms.name: The Ambush Array of Nine Gifts
long_form_mechanisms.description: A multi-layered tactical setup designed by Su Ming to kill Di Tian's avatar. It combines several independent mechanisms: (1) a blood-sacrificed grass field to mask spatial fluctuations, (2) an illusionary domain utilizing the palace fragments of the ancient Great Yu dynasty, (3) a suicide-strike from the Blue Little Sword (青色小剑) to crack Di Tian's defense, (4) the deployment of the Nine-Baby phantom to disrupt Di Tian's soul, and (5) the physical penetration of the Barbarian God Needle (蛮神刺) to inject localized poison and seal Di Tian's energy paths.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第590章 第九道大礼！

long_form_mechanisms.name: Grass Knot Puppetry / Karma-Binding
long_form_mechanisms.description: Based on the ancient Barbarian tradition of recording events via knots (结绳记事) but modified with cultivation techniques. By weaving wild grass and infusing it with hair or blood from a target (e.g., the Evil Sect elder or Bai Su), the cultivator constructs a karmic puppet. Each knot tied in the grass correlates to a constraint on the target's soul. Tying the final knot allows the user to trigger localized curses, bad luck, or direct mental feedback on the target.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第611章 发结！

long_form_mechanisms.name: Reverse Four Seasons Death and Life Road
long_form_mechanisms.description: A trial formation consisting of eight stone doors, each representing a seasonal rune (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, and their transitions). The doors simulate the degradation of life over time. To pass, a challenger must trace the runes in reverse chronological order (Winter to Autumn to Summer to Spring), representing the reversal of decay into rebirth. This requires the cultivator to adapt their own elemental energy to match the shifting environmental laws of the doors, unlocking them one by one.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第635章 逆转四季死生路！

long_form_mechanisms.name: Mortal World Soul Refinement
long_form_mechanisms.description: A breakthrough method to transition from the Sacrificial Bone realm to the Barbarian Soul realm. Instead of relying solely on medicinal pills or high-energy environments, the cultivator descends into the mundane mortal world, observing the cycles of life, death, joy, and sorrow of ordinary people. By aligning their consciousness with these mortal experiences, the cultivator synthesizes their memories (represented by Ushan and the Ninth Peak) to form a complete mental anchor, which then solidifies into a permanent Barbarian Soul.
long_form_mechanisms.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第642章 魂在人间！

originality_risks.description: Su Ming's elaborate plan to ambush and defeat Di Tian's avatar is a common narrative device in Chinese web novels. In these stories, the protagonist is not yet strong enough to face the main antagonist, so they defeat an avatar to show progress and build tension, which risks feeling formulaic.
originality_risks.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第590章 第九道大礼！

originality_risks.risk_type: The Cycles of Death and Rebirth Soul Tempering
originality_risks.description: The mechanism of the Undying and Indestructible World, where the protagonist dies repeatedly to refine their soul, is a widely used trope in cultivation fiction. It risks drawing comparisons to other classic novels (like Renegade Immortal by the same author, or other Xianxia works) where the protagonist undergoes similar soul-tempering trials.
originality_risks.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第478章 不死不灭……开！

originality_risks.description: Su Ming's adoption of the alias Mo Su and his integration into the Destiny Clan and the Ta Mu tribe to hide from a powerful enemy is a standard trope, risking temporarily slowing down the main plot with repetitive side-story structures.
originality_risks.evidence_anchor: 第三卷 名震东荒 第487章 我也是外族！

originality_risks.description: The continuous loop of Su Ming's memories almost breaking free during breakthroughs, only to be partially blocked again by a mysterious force, is a classic trope for keeping a protagonist's origin mysterious. If overused, it can frustrate readers who want a quicker resolution to the memory-loss plotline.
